transcript: I don't find the material itself to be worth your average Broadway ticket price. the laughs were cheap, and the music sounded cheap. The comedy though was definitely the focus here, It’s fun but definitely not a must see. With that, another Playbill for my collection. Spamalot is a parody of the legend of King Arthur Tonight, I saw Spamalot on Broadway. so my ticket was cheap, The set looked cheap, kind of like the show itself. They incorporated a lot of current and pop culture references based on the movie Monty Python and the Holy Grail. which got a lot of laughs. I was sitting in the balcony for this, I had a good time but and, for the most part, it delivers. Honestly, for what I paid I also thought it was pretty well paced and very well performed.
